title: Ops Resilience: Restoration Race
description: Grid secured. Now restore power to 200,000 homes without breaking it again.
storyContext: Grid secured — but 200,000 homes are dark. Hospitals have four hours of generator fuel. The Minister promised power by morning. Restore too fast and you overload the healthy grid: partial blackout becomes total.

callbacks.arc1-ch3:rebuild-full: Rebuilding everything from raw records after the NDP wipe taught you patience under pressure. Tonight needs all of it.

software-engineer.title: Program the Restoration Sequence
software-engineer.instruction: Script the power-up, station by station. Wrong order overloads the healthy grid. Arrange the steps.
software-engineer.hint: Backbone first. Hospitals before homes. Test before full power.

items.label: Confirm every hacked station is wiped clean
Bring back the main transmission stations
Run a test load on the backbone
Restore districts — hospitals and critical services first
Restore homes last, zone by zone

software-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Station by station, the island relights in perfect sequence. Hospital generators spin down. You breathe.
software-engineer.consequenceFail: Too much load too soon — breakers trip and two districts go dark again. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

data-scientist.title: Find the Safe Restoration Speed
data-scientist.instruction: The graph shows the load percentage the grid safely handled each hour. How much can you restore next hour?
data-scientist.hint: The safe limit grows each hour. Carry the pattern forward.
data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: You ride the safe limit exactly. Maximum homes lit, zero overloads. Precision heroics.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: Past the limit, breakers slam shut. The grid forgives nothing tonight. Recalculate and go again.

cloud-engineer.title: Secure Stations Before Restoring Power
cloud-engineer.instruction: Hacked stations must be secured before reconnecting — but 200,000 people wait. How thorough do you go?
cloud-engineer.hint: Restore a station the attacker still owns, and you hand them the grid back.

options.label: Rebuild every device from scratch. Takes 6 hours, but you're 100% certain the attacker is gone.
options.consequence: Six long hours. But when the grid reconnects, you know — not hope, know — it's clean.

options.label: Remove only the malicious bits you found and patch the gaps. 2 hours; 15% chance of missing something.
options.consequence: Two hours and lights-on. For weeks after, every flicker makes your heart skip. Probably fine. Probably.

options.label: Reconnect under intense observation. If the attacker left anything behind, they'll reveal themselves acting.
options.consequence: You reconnect with tripwires everywhere. Day three: a leftover implant twitches — and you catch it live.

options.label: Replace the physical equipment entirely. 12 hours, most expensive, zero doubt.
options.consequence: Twelve hours, a convoy of new hardware, an eye-watering bill — and absolute certainty. Sleep comes easy.
